subject: Hosted API pilot pricing — exec approval requested
messages:
From: Emma Ruiz <emma@skybridge.ai>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pricing for Skybridge pilot

Hi Lukas,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the model latency and cost profile look great. We have two internal asks before we can move to a signed pilot SOW: clearer per-token economics and a stronger introductory price for the first 6 months.

We’re budgeting for ~3.5B tokens/month during a 3-month pilot and would need an introductory discount north of 25% off list to make the math work for our board. That’s aggressive, I know, but Skybridge is ready to commit to a 12-month post-pilot minimum if we can secure terms that make the pilot run.

Can you confirm whether Redwood has flexibility here? If an exec signoff is required, please loop in whoever needs to be involved — we’d like to close scope this week.

Best,
Emma
Emma Ruiz
Head of Platform, Skybridge Labs
(attachment: SB-SOW-draft.pdf)
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
To: Emma Ruiz <emma@skybridge.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing for Skybridge pilot

Thanks, Emma — appreciate the clarity and the urgency.

Short answer: we can be flexible but anything >20% on Hosted API list requires senior approval.

Quick context:
- Typical pilot concession: up to 20% with a 6mo committed minimum.
- Your ask (~25%+) crosses the exec approval threshold.

I’ve attached a redlineable SOW and a short MAP of expected usage. If you can confirm the 12-month post-pilot minimum and a mutually agreed SLA for the pilot, I’ll escalate for approval today.

Proposed near-term options for speed:
- Option A: 22% discount for 6 months + 12mo post-pilot commitment (fast approval from sales leadership)
- Option B: 25% discount for 6 months + 12mo committed minimum + dedicated capacity reservation (requires exec signoff)

Which path looks better on your side?

— Lukas
Lukas Meyer | Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: REQ: Exec approval for Skybridge pilot concession (DL-9347)

Mina / Ben,

Need quick senior signoff on a pricing concession for Skybridge Labs — they’re requesting a 25–30% introductory discount on Hosted API for a high-volume pilot. Key facts below and why I think we should consider:

Account: Skybridge Labs (AI workflow platform)
Deal ID: DL-9347
ARR potential (post-pilot): $4.2M/year if metrics hold
Pilot volume: ~3.5B tokens/mo (3-month pilot)
Requested concession: 25–30% off Hosted API list for pilot window (they requested 25%+ explicitly)
Proposed Redwood counter: 25% off for pilot, contingent on 12mo minimum and dedicated capacity reservation (can include 1% incremental surcharge if load spikes)

Strategic rationale:
- High commercial upside and referenceability in our target vertical (platforms)
- They will require Private-like performance; proposing dedicated capacity reduces operational risk
- Competitive pressure: they have another vendor willing to do 18% immediate discount, but Skybridge prefers Redwood’s latency profile

Risks / mitigations:
- Revenue impact vs. list: material short-term revenue reduction (estimate: $200–300k concession over pilot) — mitigated by 12mo commit and usage bump post-pilot
- Support and capacity: will need tighter on-call and a short runbook (we can add as contract exhibit)

Attachments: deal_summary.xlsx; SB-SOW-draft.pdf (draft SOW with proposed MAP)

Ask: Exec signoff to approve up to 25% concession with the conditions above, or guidance if we should approve up to 30% and on what terms. Need response by end of day tomorrow to keep momentum.

Thanks,
Lukas
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: REQ: Exec approval for Skybridge pilot concession (DL-9347)

Lukas / Ben,

Approved at 25% for the pilot with the following binding conditions (please ensure legal and customer ops enforce these in the SOW):
1) 12-month minimum commitment starting at the conclusion of the pilot (signed MSA amendment required).
2) Dedicated capacity reservation for the pilot (we’ll size and bill accordingly).
3) Support SLA: 4hr P1 response for pilot window; upgrade path to 1hr for production with additional fee.
4) No retroactive application of the concession beyond the pilot window; post-pilot pricing reverts to standard with negotiated volume tiers.

If they truly need north of 25% (they asked for 25–30%), require a written business case from Lukas showing differentiated competitive threat and a senior exec (SVP/CEO) escalation to approve >25%. For now, move forward with 25% and the conditions above.

Mina Haddad
SVP, Sales — Redwood Inference
(attachment: approval-signoff-stamp.png)
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
To: Emma Ruiz <emma@skybridge.ai>, procurement@skybridge.ai
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pilot pricing — exec approval requested

Emma — good news. We’ve secured internal approval for a 25% introductory concession for the pilot.

Conditions (summary):
- 25% off Hosted API usage for the pilot term
- 12-month minimum commitment post-pilot (MSA amendment to follow)
- Dedicated capacity reservation during pilot (we’ll size on the MAP)
- 4hr P1 support during pilot (option to upgrade)

Next steps: I’ll send an updated SOW and MAP (redlines included) by EOD. If Skybridge still needs a deeper concession (>25%), we can discuss escalation but will need a short written case and a named exec champion.

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

— Lukas
Lukas Meyer | Account Exec, Redwood Inference
(attachment: SB-SOW-draft_v2.pdf)
